old: double wages — one wage as a herdsman of cattle, another as a shepherd
new: double wages, one wage as a herdsman of cattle and another as a shepherd
reason: Butler writes 'might earn double wages, one as a herdsman of cattle, and another as a shepherd' with commas; the edit adds a dash he did not write (PUNCTUATION §6: the candidate's dashes are Butler's own) and spaces it, whereas every Book 1–10 text paragraph prints em dashes unspaced. The added word 'wage' already fixes the two-jobs-or-two-men ambiguity without the dash.

old: Cocytus — a branch of the river Styx — flow into the river Acheron
new: Cocytus (which is a branch of the river Styx) flow into the river Acheron
reason: Butler's '(which is a branch of the river Styx)' is changed to spaced em dashes and cut down to a phrase; PUNCTUATION §6 keeps the parentheses on a phrase aside (the ground on which this same round restored ¶0's '(as it were)'), and the edition's em dashes are unspaced. The accurate gloss 'the river Acheron' stays.

old: with the first soft beard just coming on his face
new: with a soft young beard just coming on his face
reason: Butler's 'in the hey-day of his youth and beauty with the down just coming upon his face' has no repetition, but the edit's 'first soft beard' follows 'the first bloom of his youth' in the same phrase, so a listener hears 'first' twice.
